scope: proposed real TCPM/qcom owner boundary; no stub consumer or runnable permission provider
binding: actual qcom_pmic_typec device, its parent PMIC dev/regmap and TCPM port plus connector fwnode; same PMIC as input observer, no global first-port or string-only lookup

proposed_snapshot.lock: TCPM port->lock for protocol fields, short pd_event_lock/actual ingress generation for pending facts; return with no component lock held
proposed_snapshot.pd_state: tri-state UNKNOWN/INACTIVE/ACTIVE or separate valid bit; never default false for missing owner, unsupported field, read failure or inherited boot state
proposed_snapshot.positive_gate: only actual started owner, established physical epoch after inherited state resolved, sink attached, explicitly known PD-inactive, no swap/reset/protocol work or ingress pending, no unknown/error; owner API alone is not analog-route or bus-write permission

proposed_cancel.invalidate: publish monotonic event generation/abort before queue/allocation/first controller action; no sleeping join under TCPM or qcom spin/vbus locks
proposed_cancel.join: cancel publication then session cancel+join outside all component locks, before continuing a controller operation that needs DPDM ownership
ingress: qcom PDPHY SIG_RX threaded IRQ before scheduling reset_work, and reset_work before reset_on/off
qcom PDPHY MSG_RX before buffer handling; TCPM pd_receive before allocation, even on allocation failure
CC/VBUS/FRS/error events, local PR/data/VCONN swaps, Type-C reconfiguration, timers/state transitions leaving eligible phase
tcpm_tcpc_reset before locking/init; qcom remove before pdphy_stop/port_stop and TCPM unregister; PM pre-cancel in actual session owner
proposed_cancel.commit_check: session must validate same binding/physical epoch/event generation immediately before its one real bus write; cancellation joins any already started operation and exact PHY restoration before conflicting owner action
proposed_cancel.failure: keep unknown/error and no new APSD permission; do not fake cancellation completion, delay PD indefinitely or rearm on DWC rebind

errno_plan.IO_error: preserve actual errno and invalid facts

not_provided: stable PMIC seven-field two-read bus owner
current_candidate_compile: no production patch exists because there is no safe existing hook; only extracted existing-function boundary test compiled
